title: Los Angeles Celebrates Pride Month at City Hall
description:
How does Los Angeles celebrate Pride Month at City Hall? Watch highlights from the City's annual Pride Month celebration, including the unveiling of a new public art exhibit honoring LGBTQIA+ athletes eligible to compete in the LA28 Olympic Games.

LA City Hall celebrates Pride Month with a presentation in Council Chambers recognizing the LGBTQIA+ community. As part of the celebration, the City unveils Portraits of Olympic Pride in the Bridge Gallery for LGBT Heritage Month. The free exhibit features 19 LGBTQIA+ athletes who are eligible to compete in the LA28 Olympic Games and is open to the public during City Hall business hours.

Watch highlights from the event and learn more about this year's Pride Month celebration at Los Angeles City Hall.
